certification.name: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate
certification.description: Fourteen-course IBM program covering security tools, operating systems, networking, databases, compliance frameworks, penetration testing, incident response, and Security+ and CySA+ practice, with a capstone. Course-based certificate assessed through labs and projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $1,697.40 shown on the edX page (list $1,886 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
